name: expand
title: Expand
description: A long text that shows its first lines and opens on request.
use: Prose that most readers skim: a description, a review, a changelog entry. Keep links and controls out of the part that is clipped while closed.

instead.when: There are several rows, each closed to its heading

keyboard.action: Open or close the text, as the native summary does

platform.fallback: The text is hidden while closed, as in any details, and the toggle still opens it
The preview opens to its full height at once

classes.name: expand
classes.description: The details element; while closed it shows a preview that fades out at its foot

classes.name: expand-toggle
classes.description: The summary: first in the markup, drawn under the text, with a chevron that turns over

states.name: open
states.description: The text is at its full height, the fade is gone and the toggle shows expand-less

properties.name: --expand-lines
properties.description: The height of the preview, in lines of the text's own line height

Moonstone is a feldspar with a soft glow that seems to move under its surface as the stone turns. The effect comes from light scattering between thin layers inside it. Cut as a smooth dome, it shows a band of light that glides across the top. Obsidian is its counterpart, a volcanic glass, dark and smooth, with edges that catch the light.
